row.title: The hits table counts time in epoch milliseconds
row.body: seed/analytics record() writes hits.at as Date.now(), epoch milliseconds, while growth.hits_metrics and reach.live_rows bounded their 7-day window in seconds, so every raw row up to the retention limit was read as the last 7 days and the growth and reach readings were inflated. Both bounds are now in milliseconds, and tests/foundation/test_hits_window.py runs the SQL each function sends against a real SQLite hits table, so the window tested is the one the database applies. Read a column's unit from the code that writes it before writing a bound on it.
